claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says Taygetan ships can disguise as aircraft, including matching transponder data; they may also appear as lights, stars, or invisible.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Athena describes two aircraft disguises: IFF-equipped spacecraft or mini-ships shaped like human jets; some fly with conventional jet engines and fuel.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says the latter can blend among ordinary aircraft.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Toleka's tractor beam inserts aircraft into the atmosphere without lowering the ship; deployment requires operating range, direction, and line of sight.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says Federation rules discourage Toleka from descending visibly.

coverage_gaps: Other passages discuss craft shielding and propulsion, undersea cargo, cloud camouflage, and the Phoenix Lights.
